results.text:
SAYS: This letter is telling Maria Reyes about her CalFresh/CalWORKs benefits. It's asking her to fill out and send back a form by September 5, 2026. If she doesn't send it by that date, her benefits might be delayed, reduced, or stopped.
DO: Maria Reyes needs to fill out the form, sign it, and send it back by September 5, 2026. If she can't send it by that date, she should contact her worker before then.
APPEAL: If Maria Reyes is not happy with the decision, she can ask for a review. She should do this by contacting her worker before September 5, 2026.

results.text:
SAYS: This letter is telling Samuel Bright that his CalFresh application has been approved. He will receive $412 per month, starting on August 15, 2026. He must report any changes in household income within 10 days or face a loss of benefits.
DO: Samuel Bright should keep his benefits and report any changes in household income within 10 days.
APPEAL: If Samuel Bright is unhappy with the benefit amount, he can ask for a state hearing within 90 days of the date of this notice.
